name: What are common accessibility modifications for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are common accessibility modifications for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common accessibility modifications include installing grab bars near toilets and in showers, converting a standard tub to a walk-in shower or zero-entry shower, and raising toilet heights. Other popular changes involve widening doorways, installing slip-resistant flooring, and ensuring adequate maneuvering space. For homeowners in the Berkeley, Oakland, and East Bay areas, considering the existing bathroom layout and potential structural changes is an important first step, as these factors can influence the scope of modifications needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common accessibility modifications include grab bars, walk-in or zero-entry showers, raised toilets, wider doorways, and slip-resistant flooring.
